title: 제6화: 왕국 기사단장의 방문
summary: 검을 뽑은 루나 앞에 왕국의 오만한 기사단장이 나타나 검을 강탈하려 한다.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: English: Wide shot of the rural farming village under bright daylight, villagers whispering in groups, camera tracking slowly, cheerful yet tense atmosphere.

scenes.speaker: luna
scenes.shot: English: Close-up of [luna] looking nervously at the glowing legendary sword in her hand, freckled face with wide green eyes, soft warm sunlight.

scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.shot: English: Medium shot of [ignis] as a floating crimson flame hovering near [luna], glowing orange eyes narrowing, crackling sparks.

scenes.speaker: boris
scenes.shot: English: Medium shot of [boris] pointing toward the village entrance with a startled expression, heavy iron shoulder plates gleaming.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: English: Wide shot at the village entrance, a cloud of dust rising as armored footsteps echo, dramatic high-angle camera.

scenes.speaker: luna
scenes.shot: English: Medium-close shot of [luna] standing firm with a faded patch-work tunic, holding the sword defensively, determined look.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.shot: English: Close-up of a silver-armored knight's hand resting coldly on a polished pommel, sharp focus, tense mood.

scenes.speaker: ignis
scenes.shot: English: Close-up of [ignis] flaring brightly with crimson light, sparking aggressively near [luna]'s shoulder, whispering prompt.

cta: 과연 루나는 검을 지켜낼까요? 다음 화를 기대해주세요!
description: 전설의 검을 뽑은 루나에게 찾아온 왕국의 위협! 긴장감 넘치는 6화.
